content.text: Focus ResetLearn MoreNow playingMarvel Rivals - Official White Fox Character Reveal Trailer;Marvel Rivals•Mar 17, 2026Marvel Rivals - Official White Fox Character Reveal TrailerCheck out the White Fox Character Reveal Trailer for Marvel Rivals, the hit team-based free-to-play hero shooter developed by NetEase Games. Players will be able to fight as White Fox with Season 7, a legendary nine-tailed fox and Director of Tiger Division. White Fox is armed with fierce claw projectiles, area of effect attacks, and an ultimate that transforms her into a powerful fox to even the playing field.
